choices.text: Let them talk. People say more to a listener than to a question.
Nod, and keep your own counsel.

nodes.text: Germain informs me that breakfast is ready. My dear count, allow me to show you the way.
I was forced to go out of my road to obtain some information near Nîmes, so that I was somewhat late, and therefore I did not choose to stop.
He bowed. Just at that moment voices were heard hailing the concierge.

title: Villefort — a man checking the locks
